title: SalvoManifest
description: salvo.yaml at the collection root: project identity, environments, schema source.

id.description: Stable project id (uuid recommended). Scopes secret storage; survives folder moves and git worktrees.

schema.title: SchemaSource
schema.description: GraphQL schema source, consumed in plan 2. Exactly one of sdl / introspection / url.

sdl.description: Path to an SDL file, relative to this manifest.

introspection.description: Path to an introspection-result JSON file.

url.description: Endpoint for live introspection. Opt-in; many servers disable introspection.
